k17-maepji.title: How to say 'Not spicy, please' in Korean 🇰🇷 맵지 않게 해 주세요 #shorts
k17-maepji.desc:
Can't handle spicy food in Korea? Say this when you order 🌶️
맵지 않게 해 주세요 (maep-ji an-ke hae ju-se-yo) = Not spicy, please.

📍 Restaurants
🧩 맵지 않게 = not spicy · 해 주세요 = please make it
💡 Local tip: want a little kick? Say less spicy, please (덜 맵게 해 주세요).

Save this for your trip ✈️ How spicy can you go, 1 to 5? Comment 👇

k18-sikdang.title: Walking into a Korean restaurant 🇰🇷 Role-play #shorts
k18-sikdang.desc:
Korean restaurant with no English? Ask 영어 메뉴 있어요? 🍚
You: 두 명이요. (du myeong-i-yo) = Two people.
Staff: 이쪽으로 앉으세요. (i-jjo-geu-ro an-jeu-se-yo) = Sit over here.
You: 영어 메뉴 있어요? (yeong-eo me-nyu i-sseo-yo?) = Do you have an English menu?

💡 Local tip: most tables have a call bell. No bell? Say excuse me (저기요) to call staff.

Play the customer out loud. What will you order first? Comment 👇

k19-jalmeokgetseumnida.title: Korean quiz: what does 잘 먹겠습니다 mean? 🇰🇷 #shorts
k19-jalmeokgetseumnida.desc:
Korean quiz: Koreans say this before every meal 🥢
잘 먹겠습니다 (jal meok-get-seum-ni-da)
A. Thank you for the meal.  B. I'm very hungry.  C. Let's eat quickly.
Comment A, B or C before the reveal 👇

🧩 잘 = well · 먹겠습니다 = I will eat
💡 Local tip: after eating, say I ate well (잘 먹었습니다). One sound changes the time!

k20-cheoncheonhi.title: How to say 'Please speak slowly' in Korean 🇰🇷 천천히 말해 주세요 #shorts
k20-cheoncheonhi.desc:
Korean too fast? Say this and people will slow down 🐌
천천히 말해 주세요 (cheon-cheon-hi mal-hae ju-se-yo) = Please speak slowly.

📍 Anywhere
🧩 천천히 = slowly · 말해 주세요 = please speak
💡 Local tip: missed it again? Say once more, please (한 번 더 말해 주세요).

k21-gil.title: Lost in Seoul? Ask this in Korean 🇰🇷 Role-play #shorts
k21-gil.desc:
Lost in Seoul? Ask 서울역이 어디예요? to find Seoul Station 🚉
You: 실례합니다. (sil-lye-ham-ni-da) = Excuse me.
Local: 어디 가세요? (eo-di ga-se-yo?) = Where are you going?
You: 서울역이 어디예요? (seo-u-ryeo-gi eo-di-ye-yo?) = Where is Seoul Station?

💡 Local tip: need help in English? Call 1330, the Korea travel hotline.

Play the traveler out loud. Where in Seoul would you get lost? Comment 👇

k22-gwaenchanayo.title: Korean quiz: what does 괜찮아요 mean? 🇰🇷 #shorts
k22-gwaenchanayo.desc:
Korean quiz: you'll hear this every single day in Korea 🙂
괜찮아요 (gwaen-chan-a-yo)
A. I'm hungry.  B. It's okay.  C. It's expensive.
Comment A, B or C before the reveal 👇

🧩 괜찮 = fine · 아요 = polite ending
💡 Local tip: when someone offers you something, 괜찮아요 also means no, thank you.

k23-sajin.title: How to say 'Please take a photo' in Korean 🇰🇷 사진 찍어 주세요 #shorts
k23-sajin.desc:
Want a photo at a Seoul palace? Ask this 📸
사진 찍어 주세요 (sa-jin jji-geo ju-se-yo) = Please take a photo.

📍 Tourist spots
🧩 사진 = photo · 찍어 주세요 = please take
💡 Local tip: Koreans count one, two, three (하나, 둘, 셋) before the shot. Smile on three!

k24-hotel.title: Checking in at a Korean hotel 🇰🇷 Role-play #shorts
k24-hotel.desc:
Hotel in Korea? Ask 와이파이 비밀번호 뭐예요? for the Wi-Fi 📶
You: 체크인할게요. (che-keu-in-hal-ge-yo) = I'd like to check in.
Staff: 여권 주세요. (yeo-gwon ju-se-yo) = Your passport, please.
You: 와이파이 비밀번호 뭐예요? (wa-i-pa-i bi-mil-beon-ho mwo-ye-yo?) = What's the Wi-Fi password?

💡 Local tip: some elevators skip 4 or show F instead. 4 (사) sounds like death in Korean.

Play the guest out loud. Have you seen an F floor? Comment 👇

k25-han-gae-deo.title: Korean quiz: what does 한 개 더 주세요 mean? 🇰🇷 #shorts
k25-han-gae-deo.desc:
Korean quiz: say this when you want more 🍚
한 개 더 주세요 (han gae deo ju-se-yo)
A. Just one, please.  B. Two, please.  C. One more, please.
Comment A, B or C before the reveal 👇

🧩 한 개 더 = one more · 주세요 = please give
💡 Local tip: side dishes (반찬) are usually free to refill. Just say 반찬 더 주세요 (ban-chan deo ju-se-yo) = More side dishes, please!

k26-annyeonghaseyo.title: How to say 'Hello' in Korean 🇰🇷 안녕하세요 #shorts
k26-annyeonghaseyo.desc:
The first Korean word to learn before your trip 👋
안녕하세요 (an-nyeong-ha-se-yo) = Hello.

📍 Shops, hotels, anywhere
🧩 안녕 = peace, well · 하세요 = polite ending
💡 Local tip: add a small bow. Even a little nod feels very polite.

k27-ot-gage.title: Shopping for clothes in Korean 🇰🇷 Role-play #shorts
k27-ot-gage.desc:
Shopping in Seoul? Ask 다른 색 있어요? for another color 👕
You: 입어 봐도 돼요? (i-beo bwa-do dwae-yo?) = Can I try this on?
Staff: 네, 저쪽이에요. (ne, jeo-jjo-gi-e-yo) = Yes, over there.
You: 다른 색 있어요? (da-reun saek i-sseo-yo?) = Do you have another color?

💡 Local tip: staff may say take your time (천천히 보세요). Browse freely!

k28-chucheon.desc:

추천해 주세요 (chu-cheon-hae ju-se-yo)

k29-annyeonghi.title: How to say 'Goodbye' in Korean 🇰🇷 안녕히 계세요 #shorts
k29-annyeonghi.desc:
Leaving a shop in Korea? Say this on your way out 👋
안녕히 계세요 (an-nyeong-hi gye-se-yo) = Goodbye. (when you leave)

k30-yakguk.title: At a Korean pharmacy 🇰🇷 Role-play #shorts
k30-yakguk.desc:
Caught a cold in Korea? Say 목이 아파요 at the pharmacy 🤧
You: 감기약 있어요? (gam-gi-yak i-sseo-yo?) = Do you have cold medicine?
Staff: 어디가 아프세요? (eo-di-ga a-peu-se-yo?) = Where does it hurt?
You: 목이 아파요. (mo-gi a-pa-yo) = My throat hurts.

💡 Local tip: look for the sign 약 (yak = medicine). That is a pharmacy (약국).

k31-dowajuseyo.desc:
Korean quiz: the one phrase to know in an emergency 🆘
도와주세요 (do-wa-ju-se-yo)
A. Please wait.  B. Please help me.  C. Please sit down.
